facts.scope_summary: Implementation of SAP Cloud ALM for Technical Monitoring and Change Request Management (ChaRM), aligned with the S/4 RISE migration plan. Scope includes Cloud ALM tenant setup, standard change management, monitoring and alerting use cases, dashboards, training, and transition support to the METRO team.
in_scope: SAP Cloud ALM Standard Change Management
User Management in SAP Cloud ALM Tenant
assumptions: SAP Cloud ALM subscription is a prerequisite.
Customer landscape identification is required, including SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP apps, and MII.
Integration technologies used must be identified, including CPI and Integration Suite.
User/Role matrix for Cloud ALM is required.
Finalized monitoring use cases are required.
Successful go live of all the landscapes is a prerequisite for deploy/hypercare.
Cutover readiness for transport migration is required.
Transition plan and stakeholders are required.
METRO team alignment for transition is required.
Train the Trainer workshop plan and readiness is required.
Key roles/personas mapping for authorization testing is required.
Current project team support/alignment is required.
